property_summary: After a successful withdrawBalance by any actor who deposited any amount, the contract holds no ether (it sends the full recorded balance out before zeroing); the mutant zeroes the balance first, sends 0 wei, and therefore c still retains the deposited ether.
change_summary: Move the zeroing of userBalance[msg.sender] to before the external call, so the balance is already zero when the call executes and stays zero on failure.
